text:
Sam: Pager triggered for inference-serving (us-west-2) at ~14:03 UTC. Observed sustained tail latency spikes ~2.4s for the text-gen route; ~22m total impact. Mitigation: routed traffic to fallback-small model + KV cache eviction on 3 nodes; restarted modelserver on pool-a. Customer impact: several timeouts, some 5xx errors from hosted API. I want to capture immediate action items and book a postmortem.

IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager: inference-serving-high-latency (severity=2) — paging oncall Sam. Auto-routed fallback applied at 14:07 UTC. Device: g5-32x.

Jordyn: Thanks — quick notes: the latency spike correlated with a surge in long-context requests (avg seq len ~4.3K) and a bad batching window; autoscaler didn't scale fast enough. Logs show OOM retries on p3a-worker-08 before restart.

Sam: Confirmed. I collected heap profiles and kv eviction traces, saved to s3://redwood-incident/2129876501/. Captured metrics and tarball.

Anya: From PM side — we need a postmortem within 72h. Can we schedule 1hr review + action-item triage? I can host calendar invite.

Kirill: Action-item candidates I see: (A) Fix batching window heuristic to account for long-context workloads. (B) Improve autoscaler thresholds to react to request size instead of just tokens/s. (C) Hard limit on longest allowed sequence that falls back to async path. (D) Better KV eviction policy to avoid mass eviction during short blips.

Mike: Also add customer communication follow-up: identify affected customers, send incident summary and mitigation steps, and offer a brief Q&A. Prioritize for enterprise customers first.

Jordyn: Proposed sizing: A = medium (2-3 dev-weeks + 1 infra PR), B = small (3-5 dev-days + config), C = small (5 dev-days) but needs prod testing, D = medium (2 weeks + stress tests).

Sam: I already have a repro harness for the sequence-length surge (runs locally). I can own A with help from Kirill for kernel selection.

Kirill: I can take B as owner (autoscaler) and will sandbox an approach next week.

Anya: For prioritization: severity=2 incident means we should fold A and B into next quarter's core reliability sprint. C and D are important but can be scoped into Q4 backlog unless we see recurrence. Requesting explicit sizing numbers for roadmap sync: estimate story points or dev-days.

OpsBot: Auto-created ticket RW-INC-2129876501 in backlog board (incident-triage). Tags: latency, kv-cache, autoscaler, customer-impact.

Jordyn: I'll open infra PRs for improved eviction metrics and add traffic shaping tests. ETA for PR: EOD +3 days. Marking D as medium; will add test plan.

Sam: Action items summary (from thread):
- A (owner: Sam, estimate: 10-15 dev-days) Fix batching heuristic and add long-context detection.
- B (owner: Kirill, estimate: 3-5 dev-days) Autoscaler policy to include request-size signals.
- C (owner: TBD, estimate: 5 dev-days) Sequence-length hard fallback + async queuing.
- D (owner: Jordyn, estimate: 8-10 dev-days) KV eviction policy and stress-testing.
- E (owner: Mike, estimate: 2 dev-days) Customer comms + affected-customer list and outreach.

Anya: Looks good. For roadmap tie-in: propose we push A and B into the reliability sprint starting Mon (Q4 planning note: these are high ROI). C and D to grooming column; we should re-evaluate if tickets show up again in the next 30 days.

Kirill: For A, I suggest we add a feature flag (runtime) so we can rollout heuristics to 10% then 50% before global. That reduces blast risk.

Mike: I'll draft the initial customer note and sync with legal/security on wording. Will cc support leads. Target: send within 48h.

Jordyn: Quick logs snippet that looked suspicious (pasted):
```
2026-03-12T14:05:12Z modelserver[worker-08]: OOM while allocating KV cache 1.2G
2026-03-12T14:05:14Z autoscaler: observed token_rate 8200, avg_seq_len 4300 -> no scale due to config threshold
2026-03-12T14:07:01Z routing: fallback model-small applied for route /v1/generate
```

Sam: Next steps I will: attach postmortem doc (draft) to RW-INC-2129876501, schedule postmortem review (Anya please pick a slot), and start on A with Kirill.

Anya: I'll send Doodle for a 60-min postmortem within 48h. Please add any missing action items to the ticket.

OpsBot: Reminder saved: postmortem meeting created placeholder — invite pending.

Sam: Assigning owners in ticket now. Will update thread once PRs exist. Thanks all for quick mitigation. :white_check_mark:
